title: Bound Maker-GTD fill persistence by independent wallet
author: agent:/root

scope.goal: Eliminate the verified dedicated Maker-GTD queue burst caused by serial processing of multiple independent exact-family wallet/order fills for one accepted evidence event, without changing retained evidence, trading decisions, execution semantics, accounting or Live behavior.
inScope: For one already dequeued exact Maker-GTD evidence event, load the linked strategy runs for all matching exact-family orders in one existing bounded repository call instead of one call per order.

Partition matching exact-family orders into concurrency groups by the existing exposure-cache wallet key (Trim().ToUpperInvariant()), preserve current matching-order processing within each cache-key group, keep working position state separated by exact persisted copied-trader-wallet identity using ordinal string equality, and process independent cache-key groups with a hard maximum concurrency of four.

Await every wallet group before the queue completes the current evidence event or dequeues the next event, preserving the existing per-asset event FIFO, publication fence, expiry drain and no-drop contract.

Keep the existing per-order atomic repository transition, wallet advisory lock, compare-and-set retry, fill and fee calculation, cache publication, failure evidence and mandatory Maker-GTD result label.

Add deterministic focused tests for one batched run lookup, maximum-four independent-wallet concurrency, same-wallet serialization, next-event FIFO, exact-once results and failure isolation; update only directly affected documentation and mandatory requirement/context/history records.
Run focused Maker-GTD tests, a Release solution build, requirement validation and independent semantic review; commit and push only the approved local source change.
outOfScope: No Production database write, strategy/order/configuration mutation, service restart, deployment or server repair.

No change to Reference Average signals, windows, thresholds, direction, selected outcome, price, stake, GTD/PostOnly intent, TouchNoDepth predicate, event eligibility, expiry boundary, fee/PnL/settlement formulas, PaperOnly status, Live behavior or mandatory optimistic label.

No dropping, sampling, coalescing, synthesizing or reordering accepted exact Maker evidence; no change to the dedicated queue topology, general market-data queue, WebSocket subscriptions, ordinary Paper lifecycle, position-mark worker, OKX processing or database schema.

No batching of multiple wallet mutations into one database transaction, no replacement of the existing per-order atomic repository API, no increase above four concurrent wallet groups and no generalized concurrency framework.

No replay or rewrite of historical terminal orders and no claim that the local correction is deployed or that Production backlog is eliminated before a later user-controlled deployment and read-only verification.

requirements.text: Reduce repeated read work for one exact Maker-GTD evidence event without changing which linked run is accepted for any order.
acceptanceCriteria: ApplyMakerGtdUpdateAsync issues exactly one GetStrategyMarketPaperRunsByPaperOrderIdsAsync call containing all matching order IDs for the current evidence event, and does not issue per-order linked-run queries.
Each order still requires exactly one linked run whose PaperOrderId equals that order ID; zero or multiple matches record the current market-data apply failure and skip only that order.
The batch is bounded by the already captured matching open Maker order set for the one asset/event; no unbounded history scan, new repository query, schema or index is introduced.
Fill eligibility, source/receipt timestamps, event fingerprint, TouchNoDepth evaluation, fill content, fee calculation and entered-run content remain unchanged.

requirements.text: Process independent Maker-GTD exposure-cache wallet groups concurrently with a hard bound of four while preserving exact persisted position identity, cache publication order and evidence ordering wherever they are semantically required.
acceptanceCriteria: At most four distinct exposure-cache wallet-key groups for one evidence event may execute concurrently; the grouping key uses the cache's existing Trim().ToUpperInvariant() wallet identity, and the limit is local and constant and does not change service configuration.

All orders sharing one exposure-cache wallet key are processed sequentially in their current matching-order order, preventing concurrent publication to the same cache key. Within that group, working position state is kept separately for each exact persisted copied-trader-wallet string using ordinal equality, so differently persisted strings remain distinct in PostgreSQL while repeated orders for one exact string compose the same position.

All wallet groups finish before ApplyMakerGtdUpdateAsync returns; the dedicated queue cannot mark the event complete or dequeue its next event early, preserving accepted-event FIFO, no-drop, publication and expiry-drain guarantees.

Every per-order persistence attempt continues to use TryApplyMakerGtdPaperFullFillAsync unchanged, with its existing independent transaction, wallet advisory lock, validation, atomic fill/order/position/run update and at-most-three position-conflict attempts.

An exception in one exposure-cache wallet-key group records failure for that group's not-yet-completed exact orders and does not cancel or suppress already started independent cache-key groups; the event completes only after all groups settle, and no order is processed more than once.

Cache publications inside one cache-key group retain current matching-order order; differently persisted strings that map to one existing cache key retain the cache's pre-existing last-publication representation rather than racing nondeterministically.
Execution telemetry identifies the bounded independent-wallet phase without racing one shared mutable per-order operation trace.

deviations.text: Permit independent exposure-cache wallet-key groups, using the cache's existing Trim().ToUpperInvariant() wallet identity, for the same accepted Maker-GTD evidence event to complete in nondeterministic cross-group order, with at most four groups active, while retaining current matching-order order inside each cache-key group, maintaining separate exact persisted-wallet position state, and waiting for all groups before the next evidence event.
deviations.impact: This is the concurrency needed to remove unnecessary serialization observed for nine distinct strategy wallets while preventing concurrent writes to one existing cache identity. It does not change exact PostgreSQL position identity, any cache-key group's own order/publication sequence or evidence-event FIFO, but database commit/cache-publication order between unrelated cache-key groups can differ from the current single-threaded loop.

deviations.text: If one exposure-cache wallet-key group throws while processing an evidence event, let other already started independent cache-key groups finish and record failure only for the failed group's not-yet-completed orders instead of aborting all later matching orders in the current serial array.
deviations.impact: An infrastructure failure for one cache-key group no longer prevents unrelated cache-key groups from applying the same accepted evidence. Failure remains explicit and fail-closed for every affected order, but independent groups may now succeed where the current serial loop would not reach them after the first exception.
